name: code-swarm-prototype
description: Cursor swarm visualization with opt-in animation-driven, version-checked input.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: 可只读回放；应用补丁与动画输入需要受信任的工作区。

languageModelTools.name: code-swarm-animate_edit
languageModelTools.displayName: Code Swarm · 动画写入当前文件
languageModelTools.userDescription: 将 AI 生成的完整代码通过蜂群动画写入当前编辑器。
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Use this tool to apply code changes to the currently active local source file through Code Swarm's animated input. Call it BEFORE using ordinary edit or file-write tools for that change. Pass the complete final file content in afterText, not a diff. Do not perform another edit on the same file after this tool succeeds. The user will confirm the write; Code Swarm verifies the document version, keeps a local before-backup, animates each real editor edit, and leaves saving to the user. Requires a trusted workspace, a focused local file editor, and a visible VS Code window. If targetFile is given, it must match the currently active file.

afterText.description: The complete final source text for the currently active file, with no unified diff.

targetFile.description: Optional relative path, absolute path, or basename used to verify the active editor target.

summary.description: Short explanation of the requested code change for the user confirmation prompt.

codeSwarm.animationStyle.description: 混合模式：流式输入光标、小修改框选、删除红色擦除、大段粘贴和移动使用悬浮代码卡。

codeSwarm.cardSpeed.description: 悬浮卡片动画速度，默认快速搬运；数值越大，落位越快。

codeSwarm.presentation.description: Windows 默认在真实编辑器上显示动画；stage 使用并排回放舞台。

codeSwarm.pointerSize.description: 原生覆盖指针大小。空闲指针始终隐藏。

codeSwarm.cursorCount.description: Number of virtual cursors in the read-only stage.
